name: Keeper of Secrets

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Colossal Size
bonuses.text: This Threat is extremely large, swift and immensely difficult to kill. It has 35 Wounds.

bonuses.name: Daemon Lord of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 5 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Transcendent Agonies
bonuses.text: Daemons within 10 metres of this Threat (including itself) gain +2 ED to all attacks.

abilities.name: Horrific Temptation
abilities.text: Anyone witnessing a Keeper of Secrets must make a DN 3 Terror Test. Anyone who fails must move towards the greater daemon instead of away.

abilities.name: Soulstain
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Threat attempts to activate a psychic power from the Soulstain Discipline or Deny the Witch (Wrath & Glory, p. 267)

abilities.name: Mesmerising Form
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Until this Threat's next Turn, everyone within 20 metres without the SLAANESH SUFFERS a +2 DN penalty to all attacks.

options.name: Legions of Excess
options.text: A Keeper of Secrets may wield an extra weapon in its free hand. It suffers no penalty for Multi-attacks, and may attack 2 different targets as if it had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, p. 133). Living Whip: (S) + 8 +2 ED / AP -2 / Range 4 / Agonising, Rending (3). Shining Aegis: AR 3* / Shield. Sinistrous Hand: (S) +1 ED / AP -1 / Range 1 / Each time the Keeper of Secrets kills an enemy or destroys a Mob, it regains d6 Wounds but cannot exceed its Maximum Wounds.

note: Resilience printed '11+'. Colossal Size and Daemon Lord of Slaanesh are the printed names of the Champion bonus (personalRuin 5). Legions of Excess sidebar is on p.93; its weapons use '(S) +' damage, which the schema can't hold, so they stay text (the Shining Aegis AR '3*' has no footnote).
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 10d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
